materialTargets.intent: Give AGE and asset baking the same material-base constraints before lighting search. Lighting should not compensate for yellow floors or grey ceilings.

floor_polished_stone.description: Premium warm graphite/champagne polished museum stone: readable mid-value floor with color body, not grey concrete and not yellow carpet.

ceiling_warm_white_panel.description: Readable gallery ceiling panel with ivory/champagne body, bright but not grey and not yellow.

wall_black_gallery.description: Premium graphite-black gallery wall/case material: visibly black, not flat grey, with restrained bronze/champagne edge glints.

gallery_light_lens.description: Museum track light lens: warm white, not amber spotlight.

forbiddenLook: cyan lab tint on room shell
preferredLook: robot side volume from rim and fill lights

artDirection.global: restrained readable museum horror: soft natural ceiling, premium graphite-black walls, controlled metal edge glints, local exhibit readability, no yellow floor wash, no cyan/grey skin
artDirection.ceiling: large quiet warm-white area light, visible but not yellow
artDirection.floor: polished stone or worn brass reflection, low saturation and low bounce; never mustard carpet
artDirection.walls: premium graphite-black museum cases with controlled contrast, deep recesses and thin champagne side glints
artDirection.robots: enemy silhouettes must read as 3D bodies from side/rim/fill balance, never flat grey paper-thin profiles
artDirection.objects: nearby interactables and pickups get local readable islands
artDirection.horror: negative space, side shadows, reflective depth, sparse warning colors
